# What is the cheapest wholesale order that covers every stem this event needs?

> Free wedding and event florist tool: enter the stems each flower needs and the wholesale pack sizes and prices, and get the cheapest order that covers every stem plus a damage allowance. Shows spare stems, savings against buying the small pack only, and flower cost as a share of the client's budget. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
